raw_text:
PLAN "Powerlifting Meet Peaking Block - 3 Week Taper"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak squat, bench and deadlift for meet on day 21"

PHASES
  PHASE "Peaking Block" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Heavy Squat and Bench":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 4x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Heavy Deadlift and Bench Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          child_pose 1m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Squat and Bench Intensity":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x2 rpe 8..9 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x2 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Squat and Bench Heavy Doubles":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          cable_row 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Deadlift and Light Bench":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          child_pose 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Squat and Bench Singles":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Final Heavy Singles":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Opener Practice":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x1 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Sunday training 180m "Meet Day":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 9 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 9 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 3x1 rpe 9 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
